name: Icon
intent: Draws one Material Symbols Outlined glyph at a kit size, colored by the parent text color or a semantic icon role.
usage: Use Icon for every glyph. Pick a size from the scale and a tone from the semantic roles. Pass a label only when the icon means something on its own. See contracts/icon.json for the full contract.

name.note: Material Symbols Outlined ligature name, e.g. 'search', 'close', 'check'.

size.note: xs 12, sm 16, md 20, lg 24, xl 32 (icon/size scale). xs is kit-defined for Badge icons.

label.note: Accessible name. Omit when decorative (icon then gets aria-hidden).

useWhen: Any glyph inside a kit component or screen.
doNot: Do not inline SVGs or emoji.
Do not size with custom px; use size enum.
a11y: Icons with meaning must pass label, which renders as role=img aria-label.

examples.title: Accessibility
examples.usage: Most icons sit next to text and stay hidden. Add a label when the icon stands alone.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: Match the icon to the text or control next to it. sm for dense rows, md for most controls, lg and xl for empty states and headers.

examples.title: Tones
examples.usage: Inherit follows the text color. Use a status tone only when the icon carries that status.

examples.title: Filled
examples.usage: Use filled for selected or active states, like a starred item. Keep outlined as the default.
